title: Titanium Spinning Mouthpiece
description:
This titanium spinning mouthpiece is the strongest and hardest wearing of all dynavaps spinning mouthpieces. While wood mouthpieces are really nice they will of course wear over time and also soak up saliva. Especially if your friends are drooling over your awesome new vapcap.  So if cleanliness is of high importance to you the titanium spinning mouthpiece might be for you. It also adds a really nice look to all vapcaps that it is compatible with.
The Titanium Spinning Mouthpiece can be used on both the standard and XL sized vapcaps. But can NOT be used with any of the omni range of vapcaps.
If you are unsure about compatibility please feel free to get in touch. We are more than happy to help.
Included
1 x Titanium Spinning mouthpiece
